reviewer: Codex inspection of actual exported images and mechanical evidence
findings: Actual final front/rear/closeup/clay/side/reload views inspected. Six distinct bored barrels, central drive, rotating apertured plates and separate fixed bearing form a coherent heavy rotary silhouette; carry handle and stock remain seated.

Five exported firing poses verify that the cluster spins about its own fixed axis, bores and plate apertures remain open, muzzle sockets follow their barrels and barrels clear the fixed housing. The rotor plates now rotate with the tubes.

Drum has an actual guide bore; shortened fixed spindle and shaped feed bridge allow ten sampled reload poses without drum interference with spindle, bridge, receiver, grip or guard. The pull handle remains attached to the removable drum.

Shared 1024 albedo/ORM differentiates coated housing, steel barrel cluster and bronze cartridge drum. Compared with previously viewed actual project car/character calibration renders; a modest refined prototype pass with restrained material detail, not final production art.
Shared first-eight world loot. No game integration, simulated belt rounds/feed synchronization, hands or bearing physics claimed.
